name: Central European Beech Biomass Synthesis
source: Göttingen Forest Ecology Archive & Austrian Federal Research Center for Forests (BFW)
permitted_uses: Open scientific research, non-commercial and commercial allometric evaluation with citation attribution

publication_reference.citation: Zianis, D., et al. (2005). Biomass and stem volume equations for tree species in Europe. Silva Fennica Monographs, 4, 1-63.
publication_reference.institution: University of Göttingen Forest Ecosystems Dept.

geographic_scope.description: Central European Montane and Submontane Forests

collection_methodology: Total aboveground biomass destructive harvesting with fraction-specific gravimetric dry-mass determination at 105°C.

dbh_cm.name: Diameter at Breast Height
dbh_cm.definition: Cross-caliper mean measured at 1.30 m above ground level.

height_m.name: Total Tree Height
height_m.definition: Vertical distance from base of tree to top of upper canopy.

wood_density_g_cm3.name: Basic Wood Density
wood_density_g_cm3.definition: Basic specific gravity of mature heartwood/sapwood cores.

target_variable_definition: Total oven-dry above-ground biomass of stem wood, branches, and foliage in kg, dried at 105°C to constant weight. Root systems excluded.

known_missingness_and_limitations.missingness: Foliage dry mass fraction estimated via allometric sub-sampling on 45% of mature trees.
known_missingness_and_limitations.geographic_limitation: Restricted to montane and submontane Central Europe; uncalibrated in Atlantic maritime or dry Mediterranean zones.
known_missingness_and_limitations.allometric_envelope: Accurate for DBH 10 cm to 120 cm; veteran trees beyond 120 cm lack destructive verification.

processing_and_transformation_history.action: Harvest observation ingest from German and Austrian federal forest ecology plots.
Standardized residual screening (|r| < 3.0); 8 anomalous trees excluded with documented flags.
Logarithmic regression fitting with residual standard error calculation.
